target_domain: Self-generated A123-equivalent laboratory-cell surface-temperature surrogate, NOT measured pack temperature; benchmark on the fixed generator, not physical validation
generator: Frozen a=4.344635339312832e-05 K/(A^2 s), b=0.002655462788692412 1/s, nominal 25 C air; same generator used by the hold-current physics baseline
resampling: Past-held integer-second grid, no interpolation using future values. Source gaps >1.5 s split acquisition segments. Any missing grid point in history or forecast interval excludes the origin from every method.
reserve: Use each saved trace's own reserve-limited endpoint only; no extension beyond the 20% external reserve and no negative-SOC windows
features: 20: last, mean, min, max, 60 s causal OLS slope (per second), and most recent first difference of each of temperature C, equivalent current A, and air temperature C; capacity kWh and RR percent. History includes t-60 through t (61 one-second samples). Air is recovered as temperature-rise from the archived trace.
target: Direct temperature change T(t+h)-T(t); separate model for each horizon
outer: Nine leave-one-configuration-out folds; all eligible observations from one whole case held out
inner: Four deterministic group folds within each outer eight cases, two validation cases per fold. Hyperparameter score is the equal-weight mean of the eight inner-held-out case MSE values, not random-row CV.

ridge.scaler: StandardScaler fitted separately on inner-training cases and then on outer-training cases only

baselines: known fixed-generator ODE with current and air held at their present values
hyperparameter_tie_break: First grid setting in declared order; no use of outer test error
runtime_budget: Expected under 10 minutes on the small 10 s-origin dataset; hard wall-clock guard 1200 seconds, fail without partial-result claims if exceeded
metrics: RMSE and MAE in C, pooled across identical held-out origins plus per-case values and min/max across nine cases; each horizon/method has one pooled cell, 20 cells total and 180 case-level rows
usefulness_rule: A learned method is labelled useful at a horizon only if both pooled RMSE and pooled MAE are strictly lower than all three baselines. Also report per-case all-baseline win counts; no statistical independence or significance is inferred.
dependence: Overlapping histories and forecast intervals are correlated; nine deterministic configurations are not nine independent physical experiments
outputs: per-fold hyperparameter choices and training-only scaler audits
software: Pinned scikit-learn 1.7.2, scipy 1.16.3, threadpoolctl 3.6.0, joblib 1.5.2 in this new experiment folder; bundled numpy; existing matplotlib reused read-only
